parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides deeper personalization by citing specific profile values (monthly expenses, tax bracket, income figures) and offers more concrete, executable actions with specific dollar amounts and ticker allocations across all four recommendations. System B is solid and includes a useful I-Bonds idea, but has weaker grounding in some places (e.g., using stale Nov 2023 I-Bond rate, inconsistent allocation_pct fields) and less precise dollar-level actionability than A.
